Qatar LNG Site Explosion Kills 12 Indians; PM Modi Thanks Amir for Condolences

An explosion at an LNG site in Ras Laffan, Qatar, resulted in the deaths of 13 individuals, including 12 Indian nationals. Following the incident, Qatar's Amir extended condolences, prompting a thank you from Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The Prime Minister acknowledged the Amir's call and expression of sympathy regarding the accident.
